newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK pro-China paper regrets Deng to miss handover.
newsitem.headline: HK pro-China paper regrets Deng to miss handover.

text.p: A Beijing-funded Hong Kong newspaper expressed sorrow on Thursday that China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping would not now fulfill his ambition of visiting a Hong Kong reunited with China.

"The most saddening for Hong Kong compatriates and fellow countrymen is that Deng Xiaoping cannot come to the piece of Chinese sovereign land for which he led the negotiations for its return," said the Ta Kung Pao, which faithfully reflects the Chinese Communist Party line.

"But it is a comfort to his soul in heaven that the preparation for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government is progressing smoothly and that the concept of "one country, two systems" is gradually being implemented" it said.
Hong Kong will become a Special Administrative Region of China when Britain departs at midnight on June 30.
For China, the handover marks the end of more than 150 years of humiliating foreign occupation of its sovereign soil.

Deng is credited with the "one country, two systems" formula which promises post-colonial Hong Kong considerable autonomy in running its affairs and allows it to retain its freedoms and capitalistic way of life.
